gaps.what: two step gables trimmed with white stone blocks, plus a small central dormer between them
round brick relieving arches with alternating white voussoir blocks over each window
white stone blocks scattered through the brick in a Renaissance pattern below the first-storey sills

notes: One wall with two identical step gables; counts are for the whole wall since its five window axes do not split evenly between the gables. The tall ground storey has a small-paned top-light row, counted as one storey.
